Note: Dear Fellow Shareholders, In today’s fast-moving world, the challenges and opportunities faced by consumers and companies are evolving more quickly than ever. At Prudential, we’re also evolving, to maintain our competitive edge and address the changing needs of our customers and clients. During 2023, we continued to transform Prudential into a higher growth, more capital efficient, and more nimble company. To that end, we increased our capital flexibility, invested in our businesses, and worked to optimize our operating efficiency. These are crucial steps toward unlocking the full potential of our mutually reinforcing business system, a unique combination of market-leading capabilities in insurance, retirement, and investment management, which differentiates us in the marketplace and positions us for growth. Thanks to these achievements, we entered 2024 with momentum and optimism, poised to continue expanding our product offerings, enhancing customer and client experiences, and investing to grow our businesses. Sustainable long-term growth is our ultimate goal. By growing, we’ll be better positioned to help our customers achieve long-term financial security and prosperity, while generating attractive returns for our shareholders. Investing for long-term, sustainable business growth Our performance during 2023 demonstrates the progress we’ve made in transforming our company. During the year, we produced strong sales momentum across our insurance and retirement businesses and delivered solid underlying earnings growth. We also executed several transactions to reduce our market sensitivity, release capital and support our long-term growth strategy. Among them: • Reinsuring a $10 billion block of traditional variable annuities. • Partnering with Warburg Pincus, we launched Prismic, a life and annuity reinsurance company, to which we reinsured a block of structured settlement annuity contracts with reserves of approximately $10 billion. The formation of Prismic offers an exciting opportunity to drive growth by leveraging our differentiated brand, global asset and liability origination capabilities, and multichannel distribution. Thanks to the hard work and innovation of our employees, we are creating the next generation of financial solutions and delivering industry-leading customer experiences. We’re leveraging technology to bring more products to market faster. Underscoring our commitment to innovating at speed, our business and technology teams have launched an average of one new or enhanced product every two weeks. Charles F. Lowrey “We entered 2024 with momentum and optimism, poised to continue expanding our product offerings, enhancing customer experiences, and investing to grow our businesses.” Prudential Financial, Inc. 2023 Annual Report 1 In addition to launching new products and solutions, we invested in our businesses through strategic M&A and by seizing new opportunities. Our achievements included: • Enhancing PGIM’s capabilities by acquiring a majority stake in Deerpath Capital Management, LP, a leading U.S.-based private credit and direct lending manager. In addition, we united PGIM’s private alternatives capabilities into a new unit, PGIM Private Alternatives, with assets under management of approximately $240 billion, providing global investors with a cohesive set of investment solutions provided by one team. • Expanding our international longevity risk transfer business into the growing Dutch market, with a $9.2 billion transaction with NN Life, one of the largest life insurance companies in the Netherlands. It marked our first transaction in the Dutch market and our second-largest longevity risk transfer transaction, and reinforces our confidence in opportunities for growth in this arena. • Addressing demand for a workplace retirement income option by partnering with Fidelity Investments to make a new single-premium immediate annuity available to employer-based retirement plans administered by Fidelity. We also continued to invest in our international insurance businesses, including our market-leading Japanese life insurance companies, and our operations in high-growth emerging markets. Key 2023 accomplishments include: • In Japan, where we have a differentiated multichannel distribution model, we diversified our portfolio with new inheritance and investment products, to meet a broader range of customer needs. • In Latin America, we continued to expand third-party distribution of life and accident insurance through our partnership with Mercado Pago, a platform on Mercado Libre, the region’s largest e-commerce ecosystem. • In Brazil, we achieved record sales growth for the year, driven by third-party distribution and strong results from our Life Planner channel. As we look ahead, we are well positioned across our businesses to achieve our vision of being a global leader in expanding access to investing, insurance, and retirement security. Delivering enhanced shareholder value Throughout Prudential’s history, our strong balance sheet and robust risk and capital management frameworks have allowed us to confidently navigate financial and macroeconomic challenges. Our financial strength is supported by $4.1 billion in highly liquid assets, as of Dec. 31, 2023, as well as a high-quality, well-diversified investment portfolio and a disciplined approach to asset- liability management. Our systematic approach to capital deployment also enables us to effectively balance investing in the growth of our businesses with returning capital to shareholders. During 2023, we returned $2.85 billion to shareholders in dividends and share repurchases. For 2024, our Board of Directors authorized up to $1 billion in share repurchases, as well as a 4% dividend increase for the first quarter, our 16th consecutive annual dividend increase. Strengthening communities and forging paths to financial security Prudential was founded on the belief that financial security should be within reach for everyone. That belief continues to guide our work in communities and our efforts to help people now and in future generations achieve peace of mind and financial resiliency. And we’re delivering on that promise through our businesses as well as our philanthropy. “We are well positioned across our businesses to achieve our vision of being a global leader in expanding access to investing, insurance, and retirement security.” 2 Prudential Financial, Inc. 2023 Annual Report In our businesses, we’re taking a distinct approach to understanding and meeting the financial aspirations of our customers. For example, Blueprints to Black Wealth, our first holistic business growth strategy focused on the financial journey of Black Americans, is informing how we can reach new communities through financial education, products and services. We are also investing in community organizations that help expand access to economic mobility and improve social systems. In 2023, we made grants of more than $43 million, plus nearly $21 million in corporate contributions, to nonprofit organizations. In addition, through our impact investing portfolio of more than $1 billion, we’re investing in businesses and other organizations that seek to create both financial and social returns. Cultivating our talent and culture Our employees’ talents and ideas, and our unique company culture, are crucial to our ability to succeed. That’s why we continue to devote significant resources to talent management, to help our employees develop skills they need for their careers — and Prudential — to grow. For example, we’ve expanded employee access to development and career advancement opportunities through online resources, coaching circles and leadership programs. We also offer a variety of benefits to support our employees’ well-being and help them care for their loved ones. Our commitment to integrity, equity and inclusion also remains a hallmark of our company. We understand that having a workforce with diverse backgrounds, as well as an inclusive culture and business practices, is critical to understanding and meeting the needs of our customers, creating more paths to financial security for more people, and realizing our growth aspirations. Looking ahead with confidence In 2025, Prudential will mark its 150th anniversary. As we reflect on our proud legacy, we are excited about the opportunities ahead and determined to deliver on our promises and potential. We are confident that, thanks to our talented workforce, financial strength, and differentiated strategy, we are positioned to succeed and continue leading the way in expanding access to investing, insurance, and retirement security. We look forward to sharing our progress with you and our other valued stakeholders. Thank you for your continued interest in our company. Charles F. Lowrey Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
